name: Can body spray systems be added to an existing shower, or do I need a full renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can body spray systems be added to an existing shower, or do I need a full renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding body spray systems to an existing shower often requires opening up the shower walls to modify plumbing and ensure proper support, making it a more involved process than a simple fixture swap. While not always requiring a full renovation of the entire bathroom, it typically necessitates significant work within the shower enclosure. A key practical tradeoff is determining if the scope of work for integrating these systems justifies undertaking a broader bathroom remodel to achieve a more cohesive and comprehensive update. AKN Design Group can assess your current shower's structure and plumbing to advise on the most effective and aesthetically pleasing approach, prioritizing a coordinated transformation.
